title: Cardinality bound for active frequencies
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $f:\{-1,1\}^n\to\{-1,1\}$, and let $\tau$ be rational with $0<\tau\le 1$. Suppose a finite family $\mathcal A$ of subsets of $\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$ satisfies all three conditions: every member is contained in the full coordinate set; every frequency set $U$ whose Fourier coefficient for $f$ has magnitude at least $\tau$ belongs to $\mathcal A$; and, for every $S\in\mathcal A$, the restricted Fourier weight associated with the full coordinate set and the part of $S$ in that set is strictly greater than $\tau^2/4$. Then $|\mathcal A|\le 4/\tau^2$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a Boolean function on $n$ coordinates
Every active set is contained in the first $n$ coordinates
Every frequency set with Fourier coefficient magnitude at least $\tau$ has its length-$n$ prefix in the active family
Each active set has restricted Fourier weight strictly greater than $\tau^2/4$ at the full coordinate set
